description: Source code for the ExecutionFrame class in the torch::nativert namespace, managing execution state, persistent values, and output movability within a computational graph.

classes.name: ExecutionFrame
classes.description: Manages execution state, persistent values, and output movability for a computational graph.

methods.name: ExecutionFrame::ExecutionFrame
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a graph, optionally with weights, layout planner, and configuration.

methods.name: setWeights
methods.description: Sets weights and updates persistent values and movable outputs.

methods.name: getPersistentValues
methods.description: Static method to gather persistent values from the graph and weights.

methods.name: updatePersistentValues
methods.description: Updates persistent values based on current graph and weights.

methods.name: updateMovableOutputs
methods.description: Determines which outputs are movable based on graph inputs and persistence.

methods.name: setIValue
methods.description: Sets an IValue for a given ValueId.

methods.name: setBorrowedIValue
methods.description: Sets a borrowed IValue for a given ValueId.

methods.name: getTensor
methods.description: Retrieves a tensor from the stored IValue.

methods.name: tryMoveUserOutputs
